    What time is NFL Draft round 2?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    The 2nd round of the NFL Draft typically starts on the second night, which is a Friday, usually around 7 p.m. ET, following the first round on Thursday night. For the upcoming 2026 Draft, Round 2 (and 3) is scheduled for Friday, April 24, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET. 
    Here's the general schedule: 
    • Round 1 (Thursday): 8 p.m. ET
    • Rounds 2 & 3 (Friday): 7 p.m. ET
    • Rounds 4-7 (Saturday): 12 p.m. ET

      • 2021: Trevor Lawrence (QB, Clemson) - Jacksonville Jaguars
      • 2020: Joe Burrow (QB, LSU) - Cincinnati Bengals

        What TV channel is the NFL Draft on?
        An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
        AI Overview
        The NFL Draft airs on ABC, ESPN, NFL Network, and ESPN Deportes, with different channels offering varied coverage, while you can stream it on NFL+, the ESPN app, or services like Fubo. Coverage typically splits between the networks, with ESPN focusing on football, ABC offering a more story-driven broadcast, and NFL Network providing in-depth analysis. 
        Where to Watch:
        • TV: ABC, ESPN, NFL Network, ESPN Deportes (Spanish) 
        • Streaming: NFL+, ESPN app, ABC app, or through streaming services like Fubo that carry these channels. 
        Broadcast Differences:
        • ESPN:
          Focuses heavily on football analysis with hosts like Mike Greenberg and analysts Mel Kiper Jr. and Booger McFarland. 
        • ABC:
          Features a more human-interest angle with hosts like Rece Davis, analyst Nick Saban, and Heisman winner Desmond Howard. 
        • NFL Network:
          Offers comprehensive coverage with Rich Eisen, Daniel Jeremiah, and Hall of Famer Kurt Warner.
